title: Metric Definition
description: Schema for a single metric in the TriadeFlow metrics catalog

funnelStage.description: Funnel stage this metric belongs to

moduleDependency.description: List of modules required for this metric (empty = always available)

sourceModels.description: dbt model references this metric depends on

sql.description: Aggregation expression body (will be wrapped in filter_safe macro)

filterSafety.description: Configuration for filter-safe aggregation (prevents divide-by-zero, partial-filter distortion)

requiresNonzero.description: Column names that must be non-zero for safe aggregation

safeDefault.description: Default value if safety check fails (null renders as '—')

tests.description: dbt generic tests to apply (not_null, accepted_range, etc.)

owner.description: Who can edit this metric via UI

generatedFrom.description: For UI-generated metrics: 'config.custom_metrics' indicates this was auto-generated

generatedAt.description: Timestamp when this metric was generated (for UI-generated metrics only)
